prompt.alinti: Hermes just dropped one of its biggest updates yet, and it can make your agent around 80% faster. It's called Quicksilver, and there are three big changes you need to know about. First, speed. According to their benchmarks, cold starts dropped from 4.3 seconds to just 0.9, so your agent can start working almost immediately. But the bigger update is fleet routing. You can now run multiple separate Hermes agents behind one gateway, each with its own model, memory, skills, and tools. So you could have one agent for content, another for coding, and another for operations, with Hermes routing tasks between them. And finally, background jobs are more reliable. If something crashes halfway through a task, the job is stored so Hermes can recover it instead of the work just disappearing. So Quicksilver isn't another random feature drop. It makes Hermes faster, more reliable, and much easier to scale into an actual team of agents.
